title: Selected Topics in GIS; Imagery Intelligence
description: Imagery Intelligence (IMINT) is a crucial component of geospatial intelligence, providing insights through the analysis of satellite, aerial, and drone imagery. IMINT integrates artificial intelligence (AI), remote sensing technologies, and geospatial analytics through application of cutting-edge AI research and big data processing tools to the field of geospatial intelligence. This course intersects several critical domains, including disaster response, environmental monitoring, conflict monitoring, remote sensing, and advanced AI research with applications extending into national security and defense.
